name: gizza-ai/todo-organizer
summary: Organize a brain-dump into a prioritized Markdown checklist.

tool.description: Turn a freeform brain-dump (one task per line) into a prioritized Markdown checklist. Each task's priority is inferred from urgency keywords (urgent/asap/today → High, soon/this week → Medium, later/someday → Low; default Medium), and lightweight due-date hints (today, tomorrow, Friday, this week, …) are surfaced inline. By default tasks are grouped under High/Medium/Low headings (group_by=none keeps original order). Set numbered=true for a numbered list instead of checkboxes.

text.description: The freeform brain-dump, one task per line. Existing bullets/numbering are stripped.

group_by.description: priority (default) groups tasks under High/Medium/Low headings inferred from urgency keywords; none keeps the original order in one flat list.

numbered.description: When true, emit a numbered list (1. 2. 3.) instead of checkbox bullets (- [ ]).

show_due.description: When true (default), append any detected due-date hint (today, tomorrow, Friday, this week, …) as _(due: …)_.
